definition_used: A journal/publisher/institution states that one or more authors violated one or more of the journal/publisher/institution’s policy(ies). RW will use this reason when no other information about the correction/EOC/retraction is available (i.e., the notice only states that there was a breach of policy), or when the breach of policy (as an additional reason) cannot be addressed by existing reasons.
caution: The definition is a catch-all for unspecified policy violations; without further detail, it does not map to a specific manuscript-facing category. It signals a publication-policy breach but lacks content, process, or transparency specificity.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes a generic policy violation by an author, as stated by a journal/publisher/institution. It does not specify whether the breach relates to research content, authorship, peer review, or post-publication processes, so no manuscript category is directly supported.
